dogecoin.text: By investing in Dogecoin, you are investing in a meme coin that lacks real world use. This is a coin that could instantly change direction and financially hurt anyone who invested and doesn’t fully grasp the concept of crypto. (2/?)

I wanted to make a quick post regarding the significant increase that Dogecoin is currently seeing. I don’t like it and I will not invest in it. While it does bring people into the cryptocurrency market, it gives people the wrong idea on what cryptocurrency is. (1/?)
Cryptocurrency is more than just Bitcoin and Dogecoin. It is technology that will greatly impact every market, and encourage interconnectivity throughout the world. Decentralization is the future.
